xref.title: Origin of The Style Council
xref.body: The Jam was the foundational band from which The Style Council evolved, subsequently leading to The Paul Weller Movement and Paul Weller's solo career. "which all began with this band, The Jam."

xref.title: Precursor to Paul Weller Movement
xref.body: The Style Council was a band that originated from The Jam and subsequently evolved into The Paul Weller Movement, which preceded Paul Weller's solo career. "That evolved out of the style council, which all began with this band, The Jam."

xref.title: Solo Artist Evolution
xref.body: Before establishing himself as a solo artist, Paul Weller was associated with a band called The Paul Weller Movement. This group itself evolved from The Style Council, which had its origins in the band The Jam. "And before there was a Paul Weller, the solo artist, there was a band called the Paul Weller Movement."
